responsibility: This installed runtime header is the public ACLE include for the AArch64 NEON-SVE bridge API. It includes the base NEON and SVE headers and then uses `#pragma GCC aarch64 "arm_neon_sve_bridge.h"` to ask GCC’s AArch64 frontend/backend builtin machinery to inject the bridge types and intrinsic declarations, making it the user-facing trigger for the small set of vector-conversion operations between NEON and SVE domains.
